init.title: SmplWise Arx: saving automations and the service identity
init.description:
Home Assistant lets only administrators write automations, scenes and scripts. When the first switch is on, the SmplWise Arx add-on may save them for the household members it has granted that permission, for the floors they are limited to. Only content of the simple builder is saved for them; anything advanced still needs an administrator. Off by default; only an administrator can change it, here.

Service identity (optional): the id of ONE Home Assistant user who is NOT an administrator (Settings > People > Users, advanced mode shows the id). SmplWise Arx users who have no Home Assistant account act through it - only device control, the alarm, media, casting and schedules, never automations. Enter the same id in the add-on (Settings > Arx users). Leave empty to refuse every such request.

Runnable items (0.9.2): only the scripts, scenes and automations listed in the last field may be run by Arx-only users, and only in the extended mode. Enter the same list in the add-on (Settings > Arx users). Empty by default - nothing runs.

data.delegated_authoring: Let Arx save automations, scenes and scripts for users who are not administrators - simple-builder content only
data.service_user_id: Service identity: Home Assistant user id (not an administrator)
data.local_identity_extended: Extended mode for Arx-only users: doors, alarm zone bypass, scripts and scenes, live camera source (under each user's Arx permission; a security review is required before turning it on)
data.local_identity_runnable: Scripts, scenes and automations Arx-only users may run (entity ids separated by commas, e.g. script.evening_lights; empty = none). Each run is also checked here: an item whose steps open a lock, disarm, arm with bypass, call a service outside the everyday device controls or target a device the service user may not control is refused.

stream_source.name: Stream source (SMPLWISE add-on only)
